    FROM transplant_matching t

    JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON t.match_rec_registry = cm.match_comp_registry
    JOIN hla_info hi ON t.donor_ref_reg = hi.immu_don_registry
    JOIN recipients_immunology ri ON t.recip_ref_reg = ri.immu_recip_registry
    WHERE LOWER(ar.exp_rev_stat_val) = 'approved'
      AND cm.hla_mis_count = 1
),
unpivoted AS (
    SELECT a_mismatch as hla_type FROM mismatch_data WHERE a_mismatch IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b_mismatch FROM mismatch_data WHERE b_mismatch IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
